method: Existing synthetic Calendar fixture/bootstrap and actual owner/client/store handlers; new independent adversarial assertions. Actual workspace assets run in isolated headless Chrome profiles with DNS blocked and all routes fulfilled locally. No provider/account browser context is accessed.

preservedFailure.disposition: The first desktop expiry test used fixed browser+65seconds while an earlier backend fixture had advanced61seconds. It did not expire the actual returned snapshot; a valid Save completed, then five dependent desktop cases failed. Backend7 and mobile7 passed. The revised fixture advances browser Date.now to actual returned expiresAt+1 and restores it in finally; all affected jobs pass. No runtime repair is attributed to these fixture failures.

acceptedBehavior: The actual owner receives only checked date/window choices, public source provenance and freshness; no provider event IDs/titles/attendees/description/credentials are exposed, and a preview creates no booking/reservation operation.

Current visit/revision/tenant/owner/source rules fence exclusion and responses; stale changed visits and revoked sessions return no availability. Caller-invented exclusion or nonce fields are rejected.

Concurrent reordered same-range Calendar responses cannot overwrite a newer busy projection. Preview shares the durable physical-read envelope; exhausted or incomplete/provider-failed checks never become free choices.
Own reservation exclusion retains other reservations and exact foreign-event ownership checks.

Desktop/mobile actual slow preview preserves newer customer typing; the expiry gate prevents Save while preserving fields. An unchecked later date is labelled as requiring a check rather than falsely unavailable.
An older delayed UI response cannot overwrite a newer date result or a later reopened draft. Sign-out clears pending private choices.
Save rechecks actual current Calendar availability and rejects a new conflict without creating a booking or losing customer fields.
An accepted Save whose response is lost survives ordinary reload as the same pending operation; retry produces exactly one retained booking.
Observed desktop/mobile checked-choice layouts remain within viewport width; both screenshots were inspected.
Build packaging includes desk-visits.js; required gate/build evidence remains owned by Engineering and is not counted as an independent browser/provider pass.

limits.next: Root must integrate the exact accepted source, reconcile grouped release evidence, then perform a fresh bounded actual Calendar phase selecting proven-free windows. V5 connection/create/delete remain separate narrower actual acceptance.
